geometry_edits.rationale: Open the mass into two related wings so the center can become a meaningful public seam instead of a sealed lump.
Create a stronger void between wings to support the neighborhood public-space invariant.
Orient the opening toward the verified access side.
Add a courtyard as the program-visible public void while keeping the dominant mass in ancestry.
Make the void the organizational root so the ground threshold governs the composition.
Size the void to read as usable public space rather than a decorative nick.
Tie the court directly to the access edge.

graph_edits.rationale: Shift the dominant mass toward a clearer terrace/entry condition at the verified access side so the ground edge becomes legible.
Align the principal opening response to the program-frame access side.
Pull the public threshold lower so the base reads more inhabited and less sealed.
Reduce the upper block dominance to strengthen hierarchy and preserve the ground condition.

rationale: The candidate reads as a compact bent mass with a clear dominant gesture in axon and front, but the four views do not fully reinforce one spatial rule; the opposing view shows the upper volume and lower block competing rather than cleanly nesting. The stepped/cantilevered silhouette is coherent enough to avoid a generic box, yet the ground response to the verified access edge is weak: the blue frontage is not met by a legible public void, court, or entry seam, so the neighborhood_living brief is only partially satisfied. The parcel is contained, and the mass does not visibly self-intersect across views, so repair integrity is acceptable. However, the section logic is still too sculptural and sealed for a program that needs an active threshold and usable public space. Overall, it has a plausible massing language but fails the program-fit hard gate because the access-edge/public-ground relation is not convincingly articulated.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact commercial mass with a readable carved public edge and a coherent stepped/terraced upper figure.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Photographic spatial atmosphere is not the evaluation target; only the courtyard/threshold logic transfers.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Publicly legible voids and soft perimeter shaping around a compact dining/program core.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Very different scale and enclosure; do not overfit the candidate into a low-rise shop typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Small commercial frontage with a simple, clear occupied base and restrained upper mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual; do not copy. Only the idea of maintaining a clean directional span without crushing the ground threshold is transferable.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long-span pedestrian bridging as a counterexample for continuous directional gesture.

warnings: Visible access-edge response is weak relative to program requirements.
Upper and lower volumes compete in some views, reducing hierarchy.
The form is coherent as an object, but not yet as a neighborhood living threshold.
Do not reward the stepped silhouette too highly; the steps read more as sculptural articulation than as usable section.
